I am a bodyworker with over 35 years of experience dedicated to teaching others.

♥ Learn The Subtle Alignment Technique in my 10-Video Course: https://athenajezik.podia.com/foundations-of-subtle-alignment

♥ Join My Email List to stay updated on all my offerings:  https://athenajezik.podia.com/

I blend a variety of techniques in most of my sessions, including Lymphatic Drainage, Cranio-Sacral Therapy and the Subtle Alignment Technique taught in my course. 

What is The Subtle Alignment Technique?
Misalignment of the subtle structures is often at the root of chronic pain, injuries, and chronically high levels of stress hormones.  This technique offers profound benefits by unleashing the body's innate ability to heal and align itself. 

In this course, you will learn Subtle Anatomy & a protocol for assessing and aligning the subtle structures.  

Many thanks to my teacher: https://www.upledger.com/

Music by iChill Music: http://ichillmusic.com/
